# Cloud Bucket Exposure Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real, read-only request to an AWS S3 bucket, a Google Cloud Storage bucket, or an Azure Blob container you name, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on whether anyone on the internet can list its contents with no credentials.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
